_comment: Worked example: NYG @ LA, MNF Week 2 2026.
Prop LINES are hand-entered from public reporting on the afternoon of
2026-09-21 -- nflverse carries no prop markets and every book/aggregator
is blocked by this environment's egress policy. Re-check before use.
Leg probabilities `p` are judgement calls, NOT model output.
The `corr` block is the durable part: it encodes how these legs share a
game script, which is what app/core/parlay.py prices correctly.
